en.sayed-ali-raza-rizvi: 4. Muhammad ibn al-Hasan ibn Ahmad ibn al-Walid (RA) said: al-Hasan ibn Mattil said, on the authority of Ahmad ibn Abu `Abd Allah, on the authority of `Ali ibn al-Hakam, on the Hisham ibn Salim, that Abu `Abd Allah al-Sadiq (AS) said:

Allah, the Blessed and Exalted, is more Honorable than obliging people to do what they do not have the strength to do. And Allah is Mightier than allowing something to exist in His Rule that He does not intend.
